claims: The Artemis II Orion capsule successfully splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
The Artemis II Orion capsule splashed down on April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II Orion capsule splashed down at 5:07 p.m. PDT (8:07 p.m. EDT).
The Artemis II crew landed approximately 50 to 100 miles offshore.
U.S. Navy recovery teams were stationed approximately 50 to 100 miles offshore for retrieval.
The Artemis II crew was retrieved by the U.S. Navy.
The Artemis II crew was transferred to Naval Air Station North Island.
The Artemis II crew included NASA's Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Canadian Space Agency's Jeremy Hansen.
The Artemis II crew safely concluded the first crewed lunar mission since 1972.
